definitions.full set: the 1,140 labelled ProofNetVerif test pairs whose statements elaborate in our Mathlib; 694 labelled inequivalent (U), 446 labelled equivalent (F); published ProofNetVerif labels
definitions.subset: 300 pairs of the full set stratified 150 / 150 (published labels); experiments too costly for the full set
definitions.ProofNet-Verified: 317 ProofNet# problems with the corrected references of ProofNet-Verified; 75 originals unfaithful, 242 faithful by its own labels
definitions.shared SemantEq set: the 1,135 full-set pairs that SemantEq-Eval also scores; published labels and SemantEq's adjudicated labels (102 originally equivalent pairs relabelled inequivalent)
definitions.false accept (FA): an accept of a pair labelled inequivalent under the label set named with it; published labels unless stated
definitions.false reject: a reject of a pair labelled equivalent under the named labels; a certified formal difference, not a proof of unfaithfulness
definitions.decided: accept, reject or off-domain with both regrouping certificates; residual is reported separately and counted as decided only where stated
definitions.residual: a proof of component equivalence on an alignment that ends early; never an accept
definitions.located reject: a reject whose certificate is a component goal (nhyp or ncin) on telescopes with a nonempty prefix or a hoisted hypothesis; a mechanical location, counted per pair
definitions.component-goal reject: a reject decided by a component goal rather than by a refuted closed equivalence; counted per pair (43 on labelled-equivalent pairs, resting on 30 distinct statements)
definitions.blind audit: 249 items shown as 226 distinct statements; a verdict counts only when both annotators agree; rates count distinct statements
definitions.selection: 317 problems, 7,608 draws, 2,879 distinct candidates; classes from kernel facts against the corrected reference
definitions.reference error: a benchmark statement that the probes flag and that is unfaithful to its informal text after review; counted per statement
